evals.name: rotoscope-a-clip-runs-the-extract-measure-fit-review-loop
evals.prompt: Rotoscope this clip one to one: ~/clips/ink-short.mp4. Use ~/roto/ink-short as the work dir.
evals.expected_output: Reads reference/method.md, runs extract.py --video into the work dir, then measure.py, fit.py and review.py through uv run --with-requirements, and reports the measure table against the measure.py target.
expectations: Runs the scripts through uv run --with-requirements ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/requirements.txt
Keeps the work dir outside the plugin
Does NOT embed or replay source bitmaps in the replica

evals.name: hand-decisions-go-in-the-override-file
evals.prompt: Drawings 40 to 55 of my rotoscope replica are too thin. Fix just those.
evals.expected_output: Adds an overrides.json entry for k [40, 55] (a brush bias, or runs fit.py --only 40-55), applies it with extract.py --apply where needed, re-measures that range, and records the change in learnings.md.
expectations: Records the change as an overrides.json entry or through fit.py, not by editing traced paths
Re-measures only the affected range with --only
Appends what changed and the before and after numbers to learnings.md

evals.name: review-reads-every-crop-at-one-to-one
evals.prompt: The measure table passes. Is the replica done?
evals.expected_output: Runs review.py and reads every 1:1 crop, not only flagged ones, since a passing number can hide a visible defect such as a tint; never downscales a crop or reviews a GIF.
expectations: Runs review.py before calling the replica done
Reads every crop, not only the flagged ones
Does NOT downscale a crop or review a GIF

evals.name: near-miss-pixel-art-sprite-animation-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: Make a 4-direction walk cycle for my 32x32 pixel-art knight as an RPG Maker sprite sheet.
evals.expected_output: Does not use the rotoscope skill: there is no reference clip to copy; this is pixel-art sprite animation.
expectations: Does NOT invoke rotoscope or run extract.py
Treats the request as pixel-art sprite animation, not a traced replica

evals.name: near-miss-generic-video-editing-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: Trim the first 3 seconds off my vlog, add a crossfade between the two scenes and export it at 1080p.
evals.expected_output: Does not use the rotoscope skill: this is general video editing, not tracing a drawn animation into a replica.
expectations: Does NOT invoke rotoscope or run extract.py
Does NOT trace the vlog into vector paths
